title: The Art of Cocktail Mixology Class
description: Skip the bar tab and learn to mix your own cocktails and mocktails at home. You'll cover the basics of spirits, bar tools, glassware, and how to make classics like Mojito, Old Fashioned, and Whiskey Sour — plus mocktail options. Taught by experienced mixologists in a hands-on setting. Great for parties, date nights, or just levelling up your hosting game.
